answer: Price new identities like berths at a crowded jetty: each epoch the joining fee climbs steeply with how many keys registered that epoch, and every fee is burned. A lone honest newcomer pays little, but a sybil farm launching a raven-black flock of accounts at once drives the price up for each extra key, so the flood costs more than the sable-thin rewards those fakes could earn. Spreading the wave across many epochs only throttles the farm to a slow, visible trickle.
